# 5.3.0 release qualification

See the [frozen contract and evidence](../gauntlet/v53-evidence-use-2026-10-30/progress.md). The exact package/helper and final uncertainty amendment passed independent review. Publication identity is verified in its separate receipt.

Seven primary papers were read in full with explicit coverage and contrary findings. Source and helper review each found a material initial blocker; both were fixed and independently rechecked. The202-test regression suite passes with 1 skip. The helper has20 focused tests,225 unchanged independent probes and289 additional precision/resource probes.

Sixteen frozen synthetic requests were processed once under each skill by separate agents and independently graded: incumbent 15/16, candidate 16/16. The one difference is completeness of repeatability reporting, not real-task correctness or cost. These are stipulated-state simulated decisions, not executed external operations or a statistical superiority study. Source-carrier repairs after the forward capture were independently rechecked; unchanged scenario semantics are reused with that limitation.

Final archive/integration checks pass; publication identity is recorded separately. Existing110000-byte portable and16000-byte entrypoint limits are retained. Total model/research/human costs are unknown; no paid CLI benchmark was run. Caller truth, authority, semantic condition selection and universal enforcement remain outside the helper.

The owner-requested uncertainty amendment was reviewed separately (critic attempt8): low/medium/high with reasons, queries only for material choices after bounded inspection, safe groundwork and prior decisions retained. Its affected carriers/compression and exact package were independently checked; the prior16-case simulations were not rerun or relabeled as final live enforcement. Final package:15,355-byte entrypoint,109,968-byte portable; helper unchanged.
